purpose: Small source quarry for language/form adapters. These are corpus/source connectors, not new poetry products. Prefer addressed retrieval or user-supplied local extracts over bulk mirroring.

current_runtime.note: The current Poem Map can already use user-supplied corpus files without publishing or persisting corpus bytes.

normalized_item.law: source text + exact address + provenance survive every projection; corpus neighborhood is evidence/context, not automatic semantic equivalence

connectors.name: Chinese Text Project
connectors.observed_2026_09_23: 30,000+ titles and 5B+ characters; premodern Chinese corpus with search and aligned text tools.
connectors.boundary: Do not bulk mirror by assumption; use source-addressed retrieval and review site/API terms for automated extraction.

connectors.name: Project Madurai
connectors.observed_2026_09_23: Ancient and later Tamil literary works are published as freely readable/downloadable e-texts; Unicode Tamil editions are available, commonly as HTML/PDF.
connectors.boundary: Preserve edition/header provenance and follow the project's stated redistribution conditions; do not silently republish whole works.

connectors.name: Malay Concordance Project
connectors.observed_2026_09_23: 165 texts, about 5.8M words and 140,000 verses; supports contextual, morphological and rhyme-oriented search.
connectors.boundary: Treat as searchable scholarly corpus; do not assume bulk-download or redistribution rights.

connectors.name: Wikisource
connectors.observed_2026_09_23: Many language-specific projects plus multilingual works; useful as a broad public-domain/free-text bridge when no specialist corpus exists.
connectors.boundary: Verify edition and licensing/status per work/project; provenance must name the exact page/edition.

connectors.name: Perseus Digital Library / Catalog
connectors.observed_2026_09_23: Large Greek/Latin collections and catalog metadata, including substantial poetry holdings.
connectors.boundary: Rights vary by edition/translation; preserve work/edition identity rather than treating the corpus as homogeneous.

stop: Do not add more corpora until one current authoring or analysis task cannot be served by these plus local files.
